approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

params._allowToken0: flag that indicates whether token0 is accepted during deposit
params._allowToken1: flag that indicates whether token1 is accepted during deposit
params._pool: Uniswap V3 pool for which liquidity is managed

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5,05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. This is the value {ERC20} uses, unless {_setupDecimals} is called. NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically decreases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address. - `spender` must have allowance for the caller of at least `subtractedValue`.

params.deposit0: Amount of token0 transfered from sender to ICHIVault
params.deposit1: Amount of token0 transfered from sender to ICHIVault
params.shares: Quantity of liquidity tokens minted as a result of deposit
params.to: Address to which liquidity tokens are minted

params.amount0: Estimated amount of token0 that could be collected by burning the base position
params.amount1: Estimated amount of token1 that could be collected by burning the base position
params.liquidity: Amount of total liquidity in the base position

params.amount0: Estimated amount of token0 that could be collected by burning the limit position
params.amount1: Estimated amount of token1 that could be collected by burning the limit position
params.liquidity: Amount of total liquidity in the base position

params.total0: Quantity of token0 in both positions (and unused in the ICHIVault)
params.total1: Quantity of token1 in both positions (and unused in the ICHIVault)

increaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Atomically increases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller. This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for problems described in {IERC20-approve}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

rebalance(int24,int24,int24,int24,int256.details: The base position is placed first with as much liquidity as possible and is typically symmetric around the current price. This order should use up all of one token, leaving some unused quantity of the other. This unused amount is then placed as a single-sided order.

params._baseLower: The lower tick of the base position
params._baseUpper: The upper tick of the base position
params._limitLower: The lower tick of the limit position
params._limitUpper: The upper tick of the limit position
params.swapQuantity: Quantity of tokens to swap; if quantity is positive, `swapQuantity` token0 are swaped for token1, if negative, `swapQuantity` token1 is swaped for token0

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params._deposit0Max: The maximum amount of token0 allowed in a deposit
params._deposit1Max: The maximum amount of token1 allowed in a deposit

params._maxTotalSupply: The maximum liquidity token supply the contract allows

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `recipient` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `amount`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. Requirements: - `sender` and `recipient` cannot be the zero address. - `sender` must have a balance of at least `amount`. - the caller must have allowance for ``sender``'s tokens of at least `amount`.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

uniswapV3MintCallback(uint256,uint256,by.details: this is where the payer transfers required token0 and token1 amounts

uniswapV3SwapCallback(int256,int256,byte.details: this is where the payer transfers required token0 and token1 amounts

params.amount0: Amount of token0 redeemed by the submitted liquidity tokens
params.amount1: Amount of token1 redeemed by the submitted liquidity tokens
params.shares: Number of liquidity tokens to redeem as pool assets
params.to: Address to which redeemed pool assets are sent

constructor.notice: creates an instance of ICHIVault based on the pool. allowToken parameters control whether the ICHIVault allows one-sided or two-sided liquidity provision

deposit(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Distributes shares to depositor equal to the token1 value of his deposit multiplied by the ratio of total liquidity shares issued divided by the pool's AUM measured in token1 value.

getBasePosition().notice: Calculates amount of total liquidity in the base position

getLimitPosition().notice: Calculates amount of total liquidity in the limit position

getTotalAmounts().notice: Calculates total quantity of token0 and token1 in both positions (and unused in the ICHIVault)

setAffiliate(address).notice: Sets the affiliate account address where portion of the collected swap fees will be distributed

setDepositMax(uint256,uint256).notice: Sets the maximum token0 and token1 amounts the contract allows in a deposit

setHysteresis(uint256).notice: Sets the hysteresis threshold (in percentage points, 10**16 = 1%). When difference between spot price and TWAP exceeds the threshold, a check for a flashloan attack is executed

setMaxTotalSupply(uint256).notice: Sets the maximum liquidity token supply the contract allows

withdraw(uint256,address).notice: Redeems shares by sending out a percentage of the ICHIVault's AUM - this percentage is equal to the percentage of total issued shares represented by the redeeemed shares.

userdoc.notice: A Uniswap V2-like interface with fungible liquidity to Uniswap V3  which allows for either one-sided or two-sided liquidity provision. ICHIVaults should be deployed by the ICHIVaultFactory.  ICHIVaults should not be used with tokens that charge transaction fees.
